arguments.summary: fed6d69cffdf (swap [5,5]->[4,3], fixed 11-absorber mass) passed the full fidelity chain: GenVR/CFM and exact-local-MC risks 0.109 and 0.123 (<1.0), and unbiased MC gave far-field candidate/baseline 0.194 (~80.6% reduction), difference_z -23.73 with 95% CI separation from baseline; consistency z within 2.0. Deep far-field/tail (CVaR90, max, worst sector) was not CI-separated (z -1.86), so improvement is certified for the primary source-distant full-field flux but not the deep-tail hotspot objective.

action.expected_observation: Unbiased MC far-field candidate-minus-baseline z <= -1.96 with separated CIs confirming the primary objective, while deep far-field tail remains unseparated.
